spans.s:
m. (-रः)
A blacksmith.
E.
व्यो an imitative sound, and कार who makes.

m. (-शः)
ŚIVA.
E.
वोम heaven, and केश hair; also with इनि poss. aff. added व्योमकेशिन् (-शी).

m. (-री)
1 A god.
2 A bird. A saint.
3 A Brahman.
E.
व्योम heaven, and चारिन् who goes.

n. (-रं)
The city of HARIŚCANDRA, suspended midway between heaven and earth.
E.
व्योम heaven, चारि going, पुर a city.

m. (-मः)
A cloud.
E.
व्योम heaven, and घूम smoke.

n. (-म)
1 Sky, heaven, atmosphere.
2

Water.
3

A temple, sacred to the sun, or place where he is especially worshipped.
E.
व्येञ् to cover, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्, form irr.

f. (-का)
A sort of quail.
E.
व्योम heaven, and नासिका the nose.

n. (-रं)
A flag, a banner.
E.
व्योम the sky, and मञ्जर a stalk.

n. (-लं)
A flag, a banner.
E.
व्योम sky, and मण्डल place.

m. (-रः)
A gust of wind.
E.
व्योम the sky, and मुद्गर a club.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Measuring the sky, high as the heavens.
E.
व्योम, and माय what measures.

n. (-नं)
A carriage of the gods.
E.
व्योम the sky, and यान a vehicle.

n. (-तं)
The expanse or firmament.
E.
व्योम, and विल्तृत spread.

m. (-सद्)
A spirit of heaven, a divinity.
E.
व्योम, and सद् who goes.

f. (-ली)
The earth.
E.
व्योम the sky, and स्थली base or site.

mfn. (-स्पृक्)
Sky-touching, lofty.
E.
व्योम, and स्पृश् what touches.

m. (-भः)
A Jaina deified saint.
E.
व्योम sky, and आभ shining.

n. (-षं)
The aggregate of three spices, or black-pepper, longpepper, and dry ginger.
E.
वि variously, उष to burn, aff. अच्.
